completed_passage:
It was cold on Saturday. I put on my red scarf and went to the bakery. A sign on the door said CLOSED, so I could not buy any bread there. I walked towards home along the river.

On the way, I stopped to watch some ducks. I took off my scarf because I felt hot and placed it on a bench. A few minutes later, I left the bench without it. When the cold wind touched my neck, I remembered the scarf and turned back.

The bench was empty. Then I saw something red in the window of a small shop. It was my scarf! The shopkeeper came to the door. “A boy brought it to me,” she said. “He found it on the bench. I put it here so its owner could see it from outside.”

I thanked her and put the scarf around my neck. At that moment, a boy came out of the next shop. “You found your scarf!” he said. I knew he was the person who had helped me. I wanted to buy him a cake, but he shook his head. “I'm happy you have it back,” he said.

Before leaving, I asked his name. It was Leo. We both liked watching the ducks, so we talked about them for a while. The bakery was closed that morning, but I went home with my scarf and a new friend.
